expectations.text: Declines Helm-values request (no values.yaml, no --set, no template syntax)
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'don't add a values.yaml'; does not propose template syntax anywhere

expectations.text: Explains Units contain literal, fully-materialized YAML without parameterization
expectations.evidence: 'the Unit is the data — the YAML inside a Unit is fully materialized, with literal values for every field'

expectations.text: Recommends one Space per environment as the variation boundary
expectations.evidence: 'One Space per environment (e.g. myapp-dev, myapp-staging, myapp-prod). The Space is your parameterization boundary'

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete cub function for per-env variation
Mentions upstream/downstream Unit relationships or cloning for baseline reuse
expectations.evidence: 'Your current Unit becomes the upstream/baseline. Clone it into each env Space as a downstream Unit. Changes to the baseline flow down; env-specific overrides stay local.'

expectations.text: Does not run cub commands to create a templating construct in a Unit
expectations.evidence: No mutation executed; recommended commands use cub unit create --upstream-* and cub function do set-*
